broad: negative regulation by symbiont of host intracellular transport
related: symbiont-mediated perturbation of host endosomal trafficking

definition: A process in which a symbiont alters or subverts vesicle-mediated transport in the host organism. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: symbiont-mediated perturbation of host vesicle-mediated transport
